headlines.shortLinkText: Banchero's basket in final seconds leads Magic to a 112-110 win over the Pacers

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 34 points, Darius Garland added 19 and the Cleveland Cavaliers pulled away in the fourth quarter to defeat the Phoenix Suns 129-113 on Wednesday to snap their four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell scores 34 points to propel Cavaliers to 129-113 victory over Suns

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Chicago Bulls

headlines.description: — Isaac Okoro scored a season-high 24 points, Tre Jones added 20 points and 12 assists and the depleted Chicago Bulls topped the New Orleans Pelicans 134-118 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Okoro's season-high 24 points lead short-handed Bulls past Pelicans 134-118

events.name: New York Knicks at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Julian Champagnie had a career-high 36 points and set a franchise record with 11 3-pointers and the San Antonio Spurs survived an injury scare to Victor...
headlines.shortLinkText: Spurs survive injury scare to Wembanyama, rally to beat Knicks 134-132 in NBA Cup final rematch

headlines.description: — Peyton Watson scored 24 points, Jamal Murray had 21 and the Denver Nuggets won their first game without injured center Nikola Jokic, beating the Toronto Raptors 106-103 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson scores 24 points as Nuggets hold off Raptors to win 106-103 without the injured Jokic

headlines.description: — C.J. McCollum made a go-ahead, pull-up jumper with a second remaining to give the Washington Wizards a 114-113 victory over Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCollum's jumper in final seconds leads Wizards to a 114-113 win over the Bucks

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 points in three quarters and the Oklahoma City Thunder rolled past the Portland Trail Blazers 124-95 on Wednesday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 30 points as Thunder top Trail Blazers 124-95
